card.name: Author names in reference citations
card.fires_on: Commas, colons and name parts inside lists of author names in reference citations, such as after initials or before the next author's surname. Also fires on name pieces in lists of study researchers.

modes.label: Punctuation between authors
modes.description: The comma or colon right after an author's initials, before the next author or editor name.
modes.example: Spiegel DA, Hosalkar HS<<,>> Dormans JP. The spine. In

modes.label: Inside a name
modes.description: Part of an editor's or researcher's name, such as an initial or first name.
modes.example: The spine. In:<< K>>liegman RM, Behrman

modes.label: Hyphens and word parts elsewhere
modes.description: Occasional hyphens or partway-through-word pieces in medical text.

card.writes: It promotes assorted name-like and Chinese tokens, so it adds no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the author lists of reference citations, especially at the commas between names.
